sources.local: herdr integration status and session.snapshot on the maintainer host, 2026-10-16

method: One adapter at a time. An agent qualifies for a timeline only if Herdr reports an exact agent_session for its pane; screen-only agents are not possible without guessing. For each candidate, the next research step records transcript location and format, whether the format is documented, and whether approvals and questions can be read off the screen and answered by keystrokes.

fields.tier: integration (Herdr ships it), screen_only (state from screen rules, no session), self_reporting (agent reports to Herdr itself)
fields.session_ref: kind Herdr reports, from the resume table: id, path or path-or-id
fields.local_integration: herdr integration status on the maintainer host
fields.live_ref_observed: a live pane on the maintainer host had agent_session
fields.prior_art_transcript: Moshi documents a transcript-backed chat view for this agent (hint only)

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.notes: Read-only timeline shipped in bridge 0.1.x (JSONL under ~/.claude/projects). Approvals and questions captured in phase 1; PermissionRequest carries structured AskUserQuestion.

agents.name: Codex
agents.notes: No session ref under the shared daemon (phase 1 root cause). Rollout JSONL source chosen; approvals via non-deciding PermissionRequest hook; questions via request_user_input_async reply linkage.

agents.name: Cursor Agent CLI
agents.notes: Most-used after Claude and Codex on the maintainer host (3 live panes).

agents.name: Pi
agents.notes: Herdr reports a file path, so resolution may need no index; path must still be confined beneath a pinned root.

agents.name: Antigravity CLI
agents.notes: Moshi lists chat view support but no transcript source; storage format unknown.

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.notes: Moshi proxies OpenCode's local HTTP server instead of reading files: a different adapter shape.
